interpretation: A source may be computationally competent and have a perfectly recoverable private ABI yet contribute exactly zero to the sparse fusion result when behavioral applicability keeps it outside the top-2 source set.
claim_boundary: The nuisance is synthetic and behaviorally well separated from the six requested operations. Sparse top-2 gives exact zero contribution by construction when the nuisance is outside top-2. This does not yet test a near-confusable/adversarial nuisance whose behavior score approaches the useful secondary source.
